purpose: Advance one previously authenticated TrustedOrderStateV1 through an exact three-certified-header Ordinary chain, with at most one single skipped view justified by a complete TimeoutCertificateV1.

imports.source_authority: an independently verified FreshGenesis trust bundle plus Ordinary-target OrderFinalityProofV1 supplies the exact initial TrustedOrderStateV1 id and fresh-genesis finalized anchor

OrdinaryFinalityAdvanceBodyV1: TrustedOrderStateV1; verifier trust input must match state_id
TrustedOrderStateV1; derived exactly by the verifier

verified_relations: The source FreshGenesis trust bundle and Ordinary-target OrderFinalityProofV1 are strict-decoded, byte-for-byte re-encoded and fully verified before deriving the initial TrustedOrderStateV1.
The input state id must equal the exact state id derived from the source proof or the immediately previous accepted advance.
Each advance carries exactly three Ordinary CertifiedHeaderV1 values in one epoch, context, descriptor, validator set and committed parameters.
The first header is the immediate height and view successor of the trusted certified head, names its block as parent and consumes its certified-head QC id as justification.
Every block id, QC id, VoteStatementV1 root, strict Ed25519 signature, sorted unique signer set and checked weighted quorum is independently verified.

A later edge may skip exactly one view only when a complete TimeoutCertificateV1 independently authenticates the exact prior QC as high justification and lock, the exact fresh-genesis or latest-checkpoint finalized anchor, and the immediate target view.
At most one skipped-view TimeoutCertificateV1 is admitted per advance; all other edges are consecutive and carry no timeout certificate.
The three-chain finalizes its first Ordinary header and advances the certified head to its third header while preserving epoch authority, latest checkpoint and latest handoff fields exactly.
The output finalized height must strictly increase, the complete output state is independently derived, and the state and advance ids are recomputed with length-prefixed DigestV1 domains.
Two advances are sequentially composed in the corpus by exact output-state-id to next-input-state-id equality.
explicit_exclusions: No payload bytes, transaction execution, application-state derivation or enforcement of payload-dependent byte, count, evidence or execution limits; only committed header roots are authenticated.
No proposer signature; complete-node admission verifies it while this light-client candidate relies on weighted QC authentication of the exact header and BlockIdV1.
No checkpoint scheduling transition, epoch handoff, v0 activation authority, migration verification or arbitrary trust-anchor selection.
No more than one skipped view per advance, more than two composed advances, arbitrary-length history or unbounded iteration.
No state sync, non-Order proof class, complete wire or crypto corpus, second implementation or interoperability claim.
No global light-client completeness, normative freeze, node implementation, production activation or release-readiness claim.
